summary: Cisco exhibits a moderate-to-high cyber risk posture driven by persistent internal control deficiencies and frequent targeting of its infrastructure products by advanced threat actors. While the company maintains robust external security frameworks and product security teams, its ongoing material weakness in IT General Controls (ITGC) over financial reporting remains a critical governance issue. Additionally, as a major global infrastructure provider, Cisco's edge devices are highly prized targets, leading to a steady volume of zero-day exploits and data extortion attempts.
